title: Spring property names follow record metadata
summary: A record component preserves its exact spelling. An additional getter of the same spelling has no backing field and follows bean naming.

change.description: A record component preserves its exact spelling. An additional getter of the same spelling has no backing field and follows bean naming.

notes: Pair one of three altered component names with one preserved record or bean accessor.
The captured original module and its dependencies are identified by SHA-256. The setup record retains build and historical regression evidence.

The record component getWidget() and the extra getter getWidget() have identical method spellings. Only the component retained that spelling on the fix. The transplanted historical test suite failed 9 of 18 on the parent and passed all 18 on the landed artifact.

On both original artifacts the checker constructs the annotation-cache segments and reference queues and resolves the caller's declared method from its class file. All four public properties next stop at the nine-entry IdentityHashMap constructor during ClassUtils startup for optional Kotlin discovery.
